3. [Tech News] ‘We need more reviewers’: Finding Linux bugs is easy now – fixing them is another story
Some Linux maintainers are quitting under the crushing strain of AI bug reports, while others see signs for hope.

4. [Tech News] Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.
